title: Stripe
text: Stripe provides payment infrastructure for the internet. Millions of companies use Stripe APIs and developer libraries in Python, Ruby, Go, Node.js, and Java. Pay-as-you-go pricing starts at 2.9% + 30¢ per successful card charge with no setup fees.

title: Resend
text: Resend is the email platform built specifically for developers. First 3,000 emails per month are completely free on our developer tier. Integrate seamlessly with React Email and our Node and Python SDKs.

title: Pinecone
text: Pinecone is a managed cloud vector database for enterprise GenAI applications. Get started with our Starter plan featuring 1 free index with 2GB storage. Official client libraries are available for Python, TypeScript, and Go.
